subject: TERMINATE statement
notes: Format `TERMINATE { report-name-1 } ...` (cite.py --check 14.9.46.2 "TERMINATE" -> OK §14.9.46.2 General format). Grammar `terminateStatement : TERMINATE reportName+ ;` admits one-or-more report-names, ungated (Core grammar); BindTerminate resolves each name (SR1 COBOL1757 on an unknown one). Probed: single-report TERMINATE compiles and runs at --std 85, 2002, 2023 (out/probe/terminate-statement/q85.cob, q2002.cob, p1.cob); three-name `TERMINATE R-C R-B R-A` compiles and runs at 2023 (p2.cob). No spec-derived test targets the general format itself; Terminate_Gr2/ControlBreak tests exercise only the one-name form. [editions as adjudicated: 1985 (Report Writer module), 2002, 2014, 2023]
